name: XORQA
intro: XORQA 是 Gemma 3 报告中使用的跨语言问答 benchmark，包含 in-en 和 in-xx 等跨语言设置。
intro_en: XORQA is a cross-lingual QA benchmark used by the Gemma 3 report, including in-en and in-xx settings.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with The site wording (Gemma 3; in-en/in-xx) identifies IndicGenBench XORQA-IN, not original XOR-TyDi. Primary construction: IndicGenBench arXiv:2404.16816v2, Table 1, Section 2 Cross-Lingual Question-Answering: XORQA-IN, Section 3 Evaluation Metrics, Appendix Table 15, and Table 18; official data https://github.com/google-research-datasets/indic-gen-bench. Gemma 3 arXiv:2503.19786 Tables 14 and 19 supplies the reuse protocol. Original XOR QA arXiv:2010.11856 is upstream provenance only. Appendix Table 15 mislabels both rows IN-XX; the English-output row is IN-EN by Section 2.. IndicGenBench samples Bengali/Telugu XOR-TyDi sources, uses 100 train and 500 dev seeds plus a 539-example public-dev-derived test seed, and expands them through two-stage professional human translation to 28 Indic languages. Each record supports XORQA-IN-EN and XORQA-IN-XX views. IndicGenBench uses SQuAD token F1 with principal one-shot prompting, while Gemma 3 overrides this to character F-score with five shots; the diagram keeps those protocols separate.
